scheme_name: Financial Assistance Under The National Fund For Persons With Disabilities
other_conditions: Organization applying for Component 1 must be a government organization, a society registered under the Societies Act, a company registered under the Companies Act, or a trust registered under the Trust Act
The applying organization must have been registered for at least three years
The applying organization must have a minimum of two years’ experience in organizing exhibitions or workshops for marketing products/paintings
Applicant for Component 2 must be a person with disability having at least 40 % disability
Applicant must have won medals in sporting events or be graded as an outstanding/promising artist by the Ministry of Culture within the last three years
Applicant must not have participated in a similar event before
For national‑level events the family’s total annual income must not exceed Rs 3 lakh; for international events the limit is Rs 6 lakh
Applicant for Component 3 must be identified by the State/UT Assessment Board as having high support needs and the family income must not exceed Rs 3 lakh (or as specified by the Governing Body)
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for organizing exhibitions/workshops, supports participation of persons with disabilities in national/international events, and funds customized mobility equipment for individuals with high support needs.
